_comment: Reusable pitch fields + per-bucket hook templates for the DM drafter. Generated from capability_profile.json's identity + a hook library. The drafter combines: hook[opener] + niche + portfolio + honesty-gap + CTA into the ≤150-word DM format.
opener: Hi - saw your task on r/{subreddit}.
niche_statement: <one line: your niche + what you deliver, e.g. 'I design logos for indie SaaS startups.'>

cta_templates.default: Happy to send a sample or jump on details - just reply with the project link and I'll write a quick proof paragraph first.
cta_templates.code: I can ship a minimal working version in ~24h to prove the approach - want me to scope it?
cta_templates.content: I'd send a sample paragraph in your project's voice first - no obligation - so you can see the fit.
cta_templates.data: I can clean a 100-row sample of your data first so you see the output before committing.
cta_templates.translation: Happy to translate a short sample first so you can verify quality.

honesty_disclosures.audience: Honest on audience: I don't run a Substack/Medium yet - I'd publish this piece to start one. If 'existing readers' is a hard requirement, I'm not your writer and I won't waste your time.
honesty_disclosures.karma: My Reddit account is new/low-karma (I'm not a Redditor by habit) - flagging in case that matters to you.
honesty_disclosures.design_scope: I do logos/icons/banners (SVG), not full UI/UX - want to be upfront on scope.
honesty_disclosures.payment_rail: I'm SEA-based (Vietnam) - PayPal/Wise/USDT all work for me; can't take ACH/Zelle.
honesty_disclosures.always_included: State which disclosure applies based on the task type: audience for writing tasks, karma if the task implies Reddit reputation, design_scope for visuals, payment_rail if rail is unstated.

portfolio_selection.code: <your portfolio for code tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.content: <your portfolio for content tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.data: <your portfolio for data tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.bots: <your portfolio for bots tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.visuals: <your portfolio for visuals tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.translation: <your portfolio for translation tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>
portfolio_selection.security: <your portfolio for security tasks - real URL(s), e.g. behance.net/you or github.com/you>

tone_rules: No emoji walls. No hype words ('amazing', 'rockstar', 'synergy').
Name the specific task and what they asked for in the first sentence.
Lead with the real niche overlap, not generic enthusiasm.
Disclose the relevant honesty gap BEFORE the CTA - never after.
Link real portfolio assets, not claims.
Name a price only if the OP stated a budget; otherwise ask.
Human voice - write how a busy freelancer actually texts, not a template.
